Problem Statement:
You are given an integer n (may be negative). Treat the number as its absolute decimal digits (ignore a leading -). Let the first two digits (most-significant) be d1 and d2. Compute s = d1 + d2. Print 1 if the decimal string representation of s appears as a contiguous substring anywhere in the decimal digits of n; otherwise print 0. If n has fewer than 2 digits, print 0
input_spec: A number ’n’ is given to you
output_spec: Print 1 if number is ajs or 0 if it is not
